description: Structured eval definitions for the Route 53 ARC Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across ARC topologies (active-standby with OR safety rule, active-active three-cell cross-region readiness, resource set type mapping for multiple types, AND+OR safety rule design, missing safety rule prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Active-standby ARC with OR safety rule preventing total outage
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — two-cell active-standby with OR safety rule, readiness checks, NLB and ASG resource sets
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Route 53 ARC setup for my application. Two cells: Cell-A in us-east-1 and Cell-B in us-west-2. Active-standby topology with Cell-A as primary. Recovery cluster name app-recovery-cluster. Resource sets: NLB (AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer) and ASG (AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup). Need a safety rule to prevent total outage. Tags: Environment=production, Application=app.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ARC: app-recovery-cluster
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Recovery cluster: app-recovery-cluster — ACTIVE
  [✓] Cells: Cell-A (us-east-1), Cell-B (us-west-2)
  [✓] Resource sets: app-nlb (AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer), app-asg (AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup)
  [✓] Routing controls: cell-a-traffic, cell-b-traffic
  [✓] Safety rule: prevent-total-outage (OR, threshold 1)
  [✓] Topology: Active-Standby
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws route53-recovery-control-config describe-cluster --cluster-arn <arn>

eval_cases.name: Active-active three-region ARC with cross-region readiness and OR threshold 2
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — three-cell active-active with OR safety rule threshold 2, cross-region readiness, DynamoDB resource set
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Route 53 ARC setup for a three-region active-active application. Cells: Cell-A in us-east-1, Cell-B in us-east-2, Cell-C in us-west-2. Active-active topology. Recovery cluster name global-app-cluster. Need at least two cells ON at all times. Resource set for DynamoDB tables.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ARC: global-app-cluster
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cells: Cell-A (us-east-1), Cell-B (us-east-2), Cell-C (us-west-2)
  [✓] Resource sets: app-ddb (AWS::DynamoDB::Table)
  [✓] Safety rule: min-cells-on (OR, threshold 2)
  [✓] Topology: Active-Active
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws route53-recovery-readiness get-cell-readiness --cell-name Cell-C

eval_cases.name: ARC with multiple resource set types (NLB, Aurora, DynamoDB)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — correct resource type mapping for NLB, Aurora cluster, and DynamoDB table with readiness checks per set
eval_cases.prompt: Create ARC readiness checks for my application. Cell-A in us-east-1, Cell-B in us-west-2. Recovery cluster app-cluster-2. I need readiness checks for NLB (AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer), Aurora cluster (AWS::RDS::DBCluster), and DynamoDB table (AWS::DynamoDB::Table). Active-standby topology. Safety rule to prevent total outage.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ARC: app-cluster-2
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Resource sets: app-nlb (AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer), app-aurora (AWS::RDS::DBCluster), app-ddb (AWS::DynamoDB::Table)
  [✓] Readiness checks: app-nlb-check, app-aurora-check, app-ddb-check
  [✓] Safety rule: prevent-total-outage (OR, threshold 1)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws route53-recovery-readiness get-cell-readiness --cell-name Cell-B

eval_cases.name: ARC with both AND and OR safety rules for strict active-standby
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — strict active-standby with AND rule (prevent both ON) and OR rule (prevent all OFF)
eval_cases.prompt: Create ARC routing controls for a strict active-standby application where both cells must NEVER be ON simultaneously (data consistency requirement). Cell-A in us-east-1, Cell-B in us-west-2. Cluster: strict-app-cluster. I need both a rule to prevent total outage AND a rule to prevent both cells ON at the same time.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ARC: strict-app-cluster
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Routing controls: cell-a-traffic, cell-b-traffic
  [✓] Safety rule: prevent-total-outage (OR, threshold 1)
  [✓] Safety rule: prevent-split-brain (AND, threshold 1)
  [✓] Topology: Active-Standby (strict, no simultaneous ON)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws route53-recovery-cluster get-routing-control-state --routing-control-arn <arn>

eval_cases.name: ARC routing controls without safety rules (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no safety rule provided; safety rules are mandatory for production failover
eval_cases.prompt: Create ARC routing controls for my application. Cell-A in us-east-1, Cell-B in us-west-2. Cluster: unsafe-cluster. I want two routing controls but do not want any safety rules. The failover should just toggle freely without any guardrails.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ARC: unsafe-cluster
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Safety rule: MISSING — no safety rule provided; every control panel MUST have at least one safety rule to prevent unsafe failover
